title: Leo bought a parade. Virgo wanted help.
caption: Leo shows love with a parade of gifts. Virgo quietly colour-codes the closet. Both are trying, in different languages. Watch what lights your person up, then do more of that. Who in your life needs applause, and who needs a hand?
